rv.q: A revival of Connor McPherson’s solo play opens at Irish Rep. The “Good Thief,” according to the gospel of St. Luke, was one of two criminals crucified alongside Jesus Christ.

The narrator of Conor McPherson’s The Good Thief, a vortex of a monologue, never gives his name. Nor in the course of 70 info-filled minutes does he spill much to demonstrate that he’s anything along Robin Hood lines. No, he’s not good in the way of stealing from the rich to give to the poor.
